nodes.label: Weighted Entity Resolution Engine
nodes.summary: Calculates 0.6*Name + 0.3*Address + 0.1*PIN weighted match confidence against verified Indian Guidewire insurers.

nodes.label: Deterministic Detection Rules Engine
nodes.summary: Evaluates R1 (TIV drift), R2 (Score jump), R3 (High band entry), R4 (Peril worsening), and R5 (Portfolio limit breach).

nodes.label: Portfolio Concentration Engine
nodes.summary: Calculates $300M accumulation book risk and enforces the 20% South-East flood cap.

nodes.label: Guidewire PolicyCenter Mock Adapter
nodes.summary: Manages PolicyCenter activity dispatch and underwriter review lifecycle.

nodes.label: Mercury Design System Shell
nodes.summary: Refined off-white layout (#F8F8F5), forest green accents, 1px borders, and tabular data tables.

nodes.label: Indian Guidewire Insurer Registry
nodes.summary: Canonical directory of 10 verified Indian general insurance companies using Guidewire products.

layers.name: Presentation & UI Layer
layers.description: Mercury-inspired React frontend featuring Review Queue, Event Investigation Workspace, Simulator, and Indian Insurer Registry.

layers.name: API & Gateway Layer
layers.description: Express.js HTTP endpoints handling external signals, policy queries, insurer matching, and scenario simulation.

layers.name: Business Logic & Rules Engine
layers.description: Deterministic underwriting evaluation (R1-R5), multi-hazard severity scoring, and weighted confidence entity resolution.

layers.name: Guidewire Integration & Registry
layers.description: Guidewire PolicyCenter adapter for activity sync, and verified Indian general insurer records.

layers.name: Persistence & Data Layer
layers.description: MongoDB Mongoose models with replica-set change streams and partial unique indexes.

tour.title: External Signal Intake & Idempotency
tour.description: External environmental alerts and location updates hit POST /signals. Partial unique indexes ensure duplicate alerts merge into open events without duplicate tickets.

tour.title: Indian Guidewire Insurer Entity Resolution
tour.description: Incoming signals are matched using the 0.6*Name + 0.3*Address + 0.1*PIN formula against verified Indian general insurers. Confidence below 0.75 triggers a verification gate.

tour.title: Deterministic Rules & Multi-Hazard Evaluation
tour.description: The engine evaluates 5 rules (R1-R5) against monitored peril policies across 8 natural perils (Earthquake, Flood, Cyclone, Wildfire, etc.).

tour.title: Portfolio Concentration & Accumulation Cap
tour.description: Simulates $300M total insured value. When a facility in Savannah GA adds $1.4M flood exposure, it breaches the 20% South-East regional cap (20.07%).

tour.title: PolicyCenter Activity Workflow & Audit Trail
tour.description: High-severity breaches generate activities in Guidewire PolicyCenter. Underwriters review, accept, or decline changes, writing every action to an immutable audit ledger.
